issues.detail: The Greek 'ο αναπληρων τον τοπον του ιδιωτου' describes a person who is 'filling/occupying the place of an individual (private person),' but the Vietnamese 'người thường đang ở trong nơi của người thường' translates this as 'ordinary people are in the place of ordinary people,' which changes the grammatical structure and meaning from a specific subject to a general category.
The Greek 'τι λεγεις' (what you say) is rendered as 'ngươi nói gì' in a way that loses the direct object connection to the preceding action of the blessing/thanksgiving.
